reason: council-remediation-2026-07-20 agent-R: original question cited Rule XII Sec. 1213.7 stage exits, which is off-scope for an article limited to Group A dwellings (Rule VII Sec. 708 and Rule VIII Sec. 805-811). Replaced with a Sec. 708 lot-occupancy question that the article directly supports.

source_audit_support.citation: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR, Rule VII, Section 708

proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule VII, Section 708, what is the maximum lot occupancy (Percent of Site Occupancy) for a Group A dwelling on a corner lot versus an inside lot?
proposed.rationale: Section 708 limits a Group A dwelling to a maximum of 90 percent of a corner lot and 80 percent of an inside lot. The dwelling must also be at least 2.00 m from the property line and is subject to Civil Code easements of light and view.
proposed.explanation: Lot occupancy is the first check under Section 708; once footprint is set, the Rule VIII light/ventilation values (ceiling heights, room sizes, window areas) apply to the rooms within that footprint.
